findings.desc: CHK-004:adversarial:0 is not covered by the recorded evidence as written. The evidence note says `git show --name-status --oneline abeba7c -- scripts packages/main/src packages/main/tests | rg ^D` shows only approved one-time script deletions, but rerunning that command at the reviewed HEAD also outputs `D packages/main/src/core/intent-coverage.ts`. That deletion may be intentional under CHK-003, but the CHK-004 adversarial predicate/evidence does not prove the claimed script-cleanup scope until the evidence is refreshed with a scripts-only predicate or explicitly allows the CHK-003 deletion.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed CHK-004 adversarial evidence by replacing the broad `git show ... -- scripts packages/main/src packages/main/tests | rg ^D` predicate with a scripts-only deletion predicate: `git show --name-status --oneline abeba7c -- scripts | rg ^D | rg -v ...`. Reran the scripts-only predicate and it reported only the approved one-time migration script deletions, so CHK-003 intent-coverage deletion is no longer conflated with CHK-004 evidence.
